link_review_revision.scope: stop-place linking review using only the supplied citytour.csv and place catalogue
rules: stops listed in one cell with comma, &, ＆ or " 및 " are split; ASCII names such as KT&G and the middle dot "·" are kept whole

qualified catalogue names: region prefix removed or last word equal to the stop (부산 국제시장, 팔공산 동화사), unique within the region
neighbouring regions: unique catalogue name outside the course region within 30 km of the region place centroid, or 30-50 km with two or more such stops in the course
catalogued non-stay attractions used as start/end or "(하차)" points count once as visits
NON_VISIT_OR_UNRESOLVED split into NON_VISIT_STOP and ROUTE_UNRESOLVED_STOP
